checks.requirement: Audible, rounded rest chime with temporary music ducking and sound preview
First performed set today starts workout time without resetting a manual, paused, or finished timer
Remove RPE, date row, reset button, session headings and oversized empty state from set logging
Plus to log, checkmark to update, pencil to edit exercise; stable controls and keyboard layout
No snackbar for logging, updating, or completing sets; failures remain visible
Compact set rows, same muted selection style as home, no jump when selecting a set
Full-width left-to-right progress fill, no circular clock or duplicate editor, capitalized status, auto-hide at completion
Pause/resume, background completion, alert playback, and reopening do not resurrect expired timers
Editing a copied set does not silently mark it performed; completing it starts today's timers when appropriate
All recorded measurement charts appear together without selecting a type
Per-metric quick recording, compact empty metrics, accessible history/edit/delete, units preserved
Single-row range control; summary, activity, categories and records follow the chosen range
Audit nearby labels, duplicated actions, padding, retained input, and range/chart behavior
Exercise real logging, editing, rest, progress, measurement, navigation, and large-text flows with isolated fixtures
One independent review near completion, then resolve material findings
Restore pre-test data, build split ABI APKs, install ARM64 release, commit in stages

emulator_flows: Nine set rows visible without scrolling. Selecting and updating retained control positions and produced no success snackbar.
First performed set started the workout session at exactly the first set timestamp.
Rest auto-start, pause, add 15 seconds, resume, stop, and screen-off expiry. Expired service and preferences cleared, bar stayed hidden on reopening.
Android ducked a separate media player to 0.2 volume during the chime and restored it on focus release.
Training periods showed 35 sets over seven days, 62 over thirty days, and 89 over all recorded dates in the fixture. Activity and category counts changed with the filter.
Bodyweight, body fat, and waist graphs appeared together. Quick recording updated today without duplicating its entry. History Back returned to the overview.
Saving an unchanged imperial bodyweight retained exactly 74.2 kg and its note.
Dark theme and Android font scale 1.6. Found and fixed fractional pinned-header height that blanked Home. Verified Home and logging after the fix.
Completed copied set from its checkbox and observed automatic rest. Added a regression check that subsequent logging uses the completed values.
Logged 1.5 miles and 10:00 for cardio. Back returned to exercise selection with its search retained.
Installed final ARM64 release, confirmed version 1.2.0/code 2009, and launched restored Home.

Short logging layouts omitted set rows.
